#4307 asks for a clearer error, so what matters here is not that the compile fails
but WHERE the failure points. Both DXC panes report the entry point's signature
line. The statement that actually causes it is 11 lines further down, inside the
first `if`: it reads a mesh output member before writing it back. Neither pane's
message mentions that member, that statement, or mesh output at all.
Compiler Explorer prepends this banner, so line numbers below are shifted.
